author: SnooTigers959
body:
If you want to continue your T9 hydrus build, once you hit level 225/230 there are several ways you can increase damage without buying expensive T10 special hydrus class from titan workshop.

-During dragon event, get Ymir beither staff (ornate if possible) and level it to max- adorn with either all magic ^ or goat’s eye from Aries raid to increase summon stats.
-at 230 get blood pact lll
-max out magic stat as blood pact factors in summons HP and your magic to damage calculation- Aquire a heretics robe and level it up for huge magic.
